Junior IT Support -  Business Services - Brussels
jobs.description:
Are you passionate about technology and eager to kick-start your career in IT support? We are looking for a Junior IT Support Engineer to join a dynamic international environment in the heart of Brussels.

As part of the IT team, you will be the first point of contact for end users and help ensure a smooth and efficient IT experience across the organization.

Your responsibilities will include:

• Providing first-line IT support to employees.
• Troubleshooting hardware, software, and Microsoft 365 issues.
• Managing incidents and service requests through the ticketing system.
• Preparing and configuring laptops, desktops, and mobile devices.
• Assisting with onboarding and offboarding activities.
• Escalating complex issues when necessary and following up to resolution.
• Delivering excellent customer service to users at all levels of the business.

Profile

• A degree in IT or a first experience/internship in IT support.
• Basic knowledge of Windows environments and Microsoft 365.
• Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
• Fluent French and a good level of English. Dutch is a plus.
• A positive attitude, willingness to learn, and strong customer-service mindset.
• Team player with a proactive approach to problem-solving.
• Great level of English (fluent speaker)

Are you an experienced .NET DevOps Engineer with strong skills in ASP.NET Core and Azure DevOps pipelines ?

We are looking for an experienced Senior .NET DevOps Engineer to join a dynamic platform team working in a large-scale Agile IT environment.

The team works transversally across the organization and focuses on making the Azure Cloud platform accessible, scalable and easy to use for other development teams. You will work in a multidisciplinary team following Agile, Scrum and SAFe methodologies.
Role
• Design, develop and maintain reusable .NET components using C# and ASP.NET Core.
• Design, develop and maintain Azure DevOps CI/CD components using C#, PowerShell, YAML pipelines and Bicep.
• Collaborate with developers, testers, architects, Product Owners and Scrum Masters in a SAFe environment.
• Participate in PI Planning and other Agile ceremonies.
• Analyze and resolve technical issues and bugs.
• Perform code reviews and ensure high-quality code through unit and integration testing.
• Create and maintain technical documentation and contribute to knowledge sharing.
• Provide technical leadership, coaching and mentoring to less experienced colleagues.
• Continuously improve development processes, software quality and technical solutions.
• Stay up to date with relevant technologies and industry best practices.
Profile
• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, IT or a related field, or equivalent experience.
• Minimum 5 years of experience in a similar role.
• Strong experience with .NET, C# and ASP.NET Core.
• Solid experience with Azure DevOps and Azure Cloud.
• Experience with CI/CD, YAML pipelines, PowerShell and Bicep.
• Experience working in Agile/Scrum and SAFe environments.
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
• Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
• Strong technical coaching and mentoring abilities.
• Adaptability and a continuous learning mindset
 
Nice to Have
At least 1 year of experience with:

• WCF
• Blazor
• gRPC
• GitHub EnterpriseLanguages
• Dutch or French: Native level
• Second national language (Dutch or French): Basic written and spoken communication
• English: Good comprehension.

What makes this role interesting?

You’ll be involved from A to Z:

•  Prepare and test solutions in the lab
•  Implement new installations at customer sites
•  Configure and manage complex UC/IT environments
•  Troubleshoot technical challenges
•  Perform upgrades, maintenance and lifecycle management
•  Support customers remotely and on-site
•  Give technical demos and customer training
•  Work with experienced colleagues on high-end technology projects
And because technology never stands still, you’ll continuously get the opportunity to learn new technologies and expand your expertise.

 

 Your technical playground

You’ll feel at home if you have experience with several of these:

• Enterprise Voice / Unified Communications
• Cisco networking / CCNA
• Windows Server
• Linux
• VMware and/or Nutanix
• Voice & Video technologies
• IT infrastructure & system engineering
You don’t have to know everything. Curiosity and the drive to learn matter just as much as your current skillset.

 

You are analytical, structured and solution-oriented.

You take ownership, enjoy working independently but also know the value of a strong team.

You’re service-minded, flexible and customer-focused, and you’re comfortable communicating with both technical colleagues and customers.

You have:

• A Master’s degree in Industrial Sciences – Electronics/ICT or ICT, or
• A Bachelor’s degree in Electronics/ICT + 3–5 years of relevant experience
• Good knowledge of networking and Windows Server environments
• Experience with Enterprise Voice / UC is a strong plus
• Fluency in Dutch and French, and good knowledge of English
• A driving licence B

Are you ready to lead global network & security projects, from SD-WAN and Cisco infrastructure to firewall, WLAN and data centre implementations?

Are you an experienced Network & Security Specialist looking for a role that combines hands-on technical expertise, project ownership and international collaboration?

We are looking for a Group ICT Network & Security Project Specialist to join an international ICT infrastructure team in Groot-Bijgaarden.

In this role, you’ll be responsible for the end-to-end management and implementation of network and security projects, while also providing advanced support for a global IT environment serving approximately 9,000 users across 100+ sites worldwide.

You’ll work closely with network and security architects, regional and local IT teams, infrastructure specialists and external technology partners to ensure secure, reliable and high-performing connectivity.
Role
• Lead Network & Security Projects: Manage projects from the initial planning and budget phase through design, implementation, documentation and follow-up.
• Firewalling & Load Balancing: Troubleshoot, maintain and implement firewall and load-balancing solutions and features.
• LAN & WLAN: Install, configure and troubleshoot Cisco switching and wireless infrastructure across datacentres, offices, factories and remote sites.
• SD-WAN: Collaborate with global WAN providers to ensure reliable and performant connectivity across more than 100 locations.
• L2/L3 Support: Provide advanced operational support for complex networking and security issues, working directly or alongside local IT teams.
• Monitoring: Maintain and monitor network and security monitoring systems, proactively identifying and resolving potential issues.
• Technical Documentation: Interpret and maintain existing documentation and create technical/design documentation for new installations and projects.
• Infrastructure Installation: Support physical installations, including racking and stacking, initial equipment configuration, cabling and troubleshooting.
• Cross-functional Collaboration: Coordinate with infrastructure, security, HQ IT and local IT teams to ensure successful project delivery.
• Prioritisation: Balance project responsibilities with operational support and maintenance, ensuring business-critical activities receive the appropriate priority.
You’ll also participate in a 24/7 standby rotation for critical incidents, approximately once every 8 weeks.

Profile
We’re looking for a technically strong and hands-on professional who enjoys solving complex problems and taking ownership of projects.
Required
• 5+ years of relevant experience in LAN/WAN, networking and/or security.
• Strong knowledge of:
• SD-WAN
• Firewall and Cloud Proxy technologies
• Cisco wired and wireless networking
• TCP/IP and OSI layers 1–7
• Switching and routing
• Wireless networking
• Firewall troubleshooting
• Experience managing network/security projects from planning through implementation.
• Excellent troubleshooting and analytical skills.
• Hands-on mentality with a proactive approach.
• Ability to work independently and manage priorities effectively.
• Strong communication and collaboration skills.
• Ability to understand business requirements and translate them into effective technical solutions.
• Stress-resistant and comfortable working in a global environment.Nice to have
Experience with:

• Cisco Identity Services Engine (ISE) or equivalent
• Cisco Nexus
• F5 Load Balancers
• Palo Alto Firewalls
• Sophos Firewalls
• Azure Network Fundamentals
• Wireless standards
• Monitoring technologies such as NetFlow, SNMP, Syslog and real-time alerts
• Certifications such as CCNA, CCNP, Palo Alto, F5, or equivalentLanguages & travel
• English: strong professional proficiency
• Dutch and French: required
• Comfortable working with international colleagues and stakeholders.
• Willing to travel internationally for short assignments of 5–10 days, approximately 1–2 times per year.

Are you passionate about building secure cloud environments and embedding security into every stage of software delivery? In this role, you will help shape a security-first culture by integrating security into development processes, strengthening cloud environments, and enabling teams to deliver resilient applications at scale.

What you'll do

• You design, build and maintain automated security controls within CI/CD pipelines, ensuring security is embedded throughout the software development lifecycle.
• Working closely with development, cloud and operations teams, you help implement security-by-design practices across AWS and Azure environments.
• You assess cloud security posture, identify risks and lead remediation efforts to improve compliance with security frameworks and benchmarks.
• You support the security of containerized platforms and infrastructure-as-code solutions by promoting secure configurations and automation.
• You provide expertise on secure coding standards, DevSecOps tooling and application security practices, helping teams strengthen their security maturity.
• By monitoring key security indicators and supporting incident investigations, you contribute to the continuous improvement of Luminus' cyber resilience.
 

What you bring

• Proven experience in DevSecOps, cloud security or application security, with a strong understanding of CI/CD environments and security automation.
• Experience working with security technologies such as SAST, DAST, SCA, secrets management solutions, Terraform and software supply chain security practices.
• Strong knowledge of cloud and container technologies, including AWS, Azure, Kubernetes and related security concepts.
• Your understanding of application security principles, OWASP guidelines and vulnerability management enables you to identify and address security risks effectively.
• A collaborative mindset that allows you to work effectively with developers, cloud experts, project teams and external partners.
• Professional proficiency in English and fluency in Dutch and/or French.

Join a hands-on IT team where networking isn’t just about maintaining infrastructure : it’s about building, securing and continuously improving it.

We are looking for aNetwork Engineerto join a collaborative and hands-on team, working closely with internal IT specialists and external partners.

 

What makes this role different?You’ll be close to the technology.You’ll actively work on the infrastructure, troubleshoot real-world challenges and contribute to network and security projects rather than simply managing tickets from the sidelines.
Network Engineer - What's the job about
• Network Infrastructure:Design, configure and maintain enterprise network environments, with a strong focus onFortinet & Palo Altotechnologies.
• Network Security:Managefirewalls, VPNs, IDS/IPS and security policies, ensuring a secure and reliable infrastructure.
• Hands-on Troubleshooting:Investigate complex network issues, identify root causes and implement effective solutions using tools such asWireshark, PRTG or SolarWinds.
• Projects & Improvements:Contribute tonetwork upgrades, segmentation, SD-WAN and security projects, from implementation through to optimisation.
• Collaboration:Work closely withIT teams, vendors and service providersto integrate and improve network solutions.
• Documentation:Keep network configurations, diagrams, procedures and technical documentation accurate and up to date.
Network Engineer - Who we are looking for
• 4+ years of experiencein network administration or network engineering, ideally in a complex IT environment.
• Strong hands-on expertise withFortinetsolutions, including FortiGate, FortiManager, FortiAnalyzer and VPNs.
• Solid experience withPalo Alto, particularly firewalls, Panorama and GlobalProtect.
• Strong understanding ofTCP/IP, VLANs, routing, OSPF/BGP, DNS, DHCP and network segmentation.
• A genuineproblem-solverwho enjoys troubleshooting, getting into the technical details and finding practical solutions.
• Fluent in English and French, with good communication skills and the ability to work effectively within a team.

jobs.occupation: 3rd Line Support Engineer | B2B software solutions
jobs.description:
Do you thrive in fast-paced environments where no two days are the same? Then this Brussels-based opportunity might be exactly what you're looking for!

Our client is a growing company focused on IT services and professional B2B software solutions. They are currently seeking a motivatedSupport Engineer (3rd line)ready to take on technical challenges and deliver high-quality service to clients.

• Identify potential technical issues early and implement preventive measures to minimize downtime.
• Handle hardware and network equipment, making sure all devices are properly configured and up to date.

Support Engineer - Your Profile
• Junior to mid-level experience (minimum 3 years in a similar role).
• Fluent in French and English; Dutch is considered an advantage.
• Strong technical background with tools and technologies such as Microsoft 365, PowerShell, SharePoint, Apple environments, Cisco, VPNs, DNS, firewalls, and switching.
• Able to work independently while taking initiative when needed.
• Customer-focused mindset with a proactive, solution-oriented approach.

Within the Services department, you are responsible for the management (remote) of various mission critical systems installed at the customers. If a problem arises, you analyse the problem and, together with the team, find the best solution. You do not only perform classic maintenance tasks, but you are also responsible for proactively monitoring the systems, rolling out upgrades and lifecycle management. You will be trained in various new technologies. And you participate in the implementation of new installations at customers in close cooperation with the Project Engineers and Project Managers.

Implementation of projects:

• In a lab environment, you prepare future installations.
• You install the solution at the customer's site and put it into service. 
• You give training to key users and administrators.
Maintenance:

• You perform ( remote) corrective maintenance on various mission critical systems.
• You perform updates and upgrades on existing systems.
• You perform preventive visits in the context of maintenance contracts.

Profile

• Must have: Bachelor, Master or Engineer in Electronics,Information Technology, Telecommunication...
• Fluent in Dutch, good knowledge of English and French are a major assets
• Good understanding of virtualisation (VMware, Nutanix)
• Expertise in Windows server environments
• Enterprise Networking (Switching, Routing, TCP/IP)

• Analytical mind, well organised, flexibility, eagerness to learn are key in this position
• Open to participate in the on call rotation within your team after a few months of practice
• Troubleshooting Complex Critical Environments
• Technical Consulting and Customer Interaction
• Driver Licence B
• Professional with up to 4 years of experience

Our client is a Brussels-based company operating in a technical and regulated environment, with an international scope. It stands out for its pragmatic mindset, family-oriented culture, high-quality approach and products, as well as its continuous drive to modernize internal tools and processes.
As part of its digital transformation and the structuring of its IT function, our client is looking to strengthen its team by recruiting an IT Coordinator who will play a central role between users, management, and external partners.

As an IT Coordinator, you will hold a key, cross-functional position, combining both operational and organizational responsibilities.

You will cover the full IT scope: user support, infrastructure, business applications, and coordination of external service providers.
You will actively contribute to the company's digitalization and ensure the continuity, reliability, and ongoing development of its IT systems.

Your responsibilities :

• Provide Level 1 and Level 2 IT support to users (workstations, software, access, etc.).
• Manage and maintain IT infrastructure (networks, servers, cloud environments, security).
• Administer and optimize business applications in collaboration with an external consultant (CRM, webshop, internal tools, Office 365, etc.).
• Lead IT projects (new tools, improvements, migrations) in collaboration with various departments (e.g. CRM implementation project).
• Coordinate and manage external IT vendors and service providers.
• Identify innovation opportunities and propose continuous improvements to systems and processes.
• Support users and management through change and the adoption of new tools

Profile

• Minimum 5 years of experience in an IT coordination role or similar position.
• Versatile profile, comfortable with support, infrastructure, applications, and project management.
• Experience working with external IT service providers.
• Strong knowledge of Microsoft Office 365 and collaborative environments.
• Excellent organizational, autonomy, and communication skills.
• Strong sense of innovation and a genuine ability to support change.
• Languages: French and English required; Dutch is a strong asset (trilingual profile is a major plus).

Our client is an international company headquartered in the Antwerpen region with over 30 years of experience at the international scale. They are looking for an IT Project Manager acting as a primary stakeholder in project coordination (applications and infrastructure) as well as technologies related to SAP within the company.

The IT Project Manager is a key stakeholder in project coordination concerning all IT-related matters within the company. This individual will collaborate with internal business stakeholders and external support partners to ensure smooth day-to-day operations. The role requires a business-focused expert who can advocate for user needs and take the necessary actions for planning and support.

Key responsibilities:

Business System Support:

• Act as a super-user and system expert for SAP (ERP), specifically for the S4Hana and Coupa modules (with 80% of the projects being finance-related).
• Understand the architecture and process flows of ERP, Process Control, and related manufacturing systems
• Monitor system health and stability.
• Troubleshoot and address system issues, outages, and functional needs, engaging support partners as needed
• Support business users as a subject matter expert on existing and proposed system functionality
• Act as program manager and project stakeholder for system upgrades and enhancements

End User Support:

• Act as the first responder for user desktop issues (hardware and software), engaging the help desk and support partners as needed.
• Facilitate requests for purchases.
• Observe and anticipate user needs, and make appropriate recommendations for improvement.

Infrastructure, Process and Policy:

• Assist users in understanding IT Policy, Process, and Systems.
• Support business leadership in strategic planning and project oversight.
• Coordinate site activities for upgrades and system maintenance.
• Make recommendations for enhancements that will improve system function, capabilities, and stability.

Profile

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in IT or engineering field.
• Proven ability to work across functional and regional boundaries, challenge status quo, and handle multiple projects simultaneously while delivering on time and on budget.
• Fluent in English with excellent communication and change management skills.
• 3-8 years' experience in IT role in a global company.
• Mixed skills should include configuration and expertise in SAP Coupa and S4Hana.

Responsibilities

• Design and build Layer 3 data models and scalable ETL/ELT pipelines in a cloud environment.
• Integrate disparate data sources including demand, supply, and financial actuals into unified datasets.
• Develop and maintain advanced transformation flows to support migrations from legacy systems to modern architectures.
• Translate ambiguous business requirements into structured data solutions and actionable insights.
• Enable scalable reporting by building robust data models and dashboards for executive decision-making.
• Identify pragmatic AI use cases for forecasting improvements and trend detection.

Requirements

• 8+ years of data engineering experience focusing on Snowflake and expert-level SQL.
• 8+ years of experience in business intelligence using Tableau (Desktop and Prep) and Power BI.
• Extensive experience designing ETL/ELT frameworks and data transformation pipelines.
• In-depth functional knowledge of portfolio planning, resource forecasting, and financial planning.
• Proven expertise in data modeling and performance optimization for large-scale transformations.
• Strong experience integrating cross-domain enterprise data from systems like SAP HANA.
• You possess strong problem-solving and root cause analysis skills to resolve cross-system data inconsistencies.
• You bring exceptional technical communication skills to engage with both IT and business stakeholders.
• You are fluent in English.
Nice to Haves

Work in an international IT environment where you’ll collaborate daily with engineers across Europe and take ownership of a diverse infrastructure.

As aSenior System Engineer, you will join a small and technically versatile IT team, working closely with engineers and colleagues across different countries. United by a shared purpose, we’re building a smarter, trustful and more connected world. 
That means embracing technology and celebrating change. We think possible and then make it possible. And of course, we love what we do. 
Sounds like your kind of place?

Your job

What can you expect from this role? 

You will be part of our MSP teams focusing on Managed Detection and Response (MDR). The SRE team focuses on the backend platformization and automation side of the MDR service. Aspects like reliability, scalability, automation and efficiency of our managed service provider (MSP) technology stack are extremely important for Davinsi Labs. Your primary objective as an engineer will be to continuously enhance these capabilities across different complex customer environments. • AWS
• GitHub
• Nutanix Prism
• HashiCorp Terraform
• HashiCorp Vault

 Hello, is it me you're looking for?

jobs.occupation: Senior Accountant in Brussels - International company

jobs.description:

 In this role you will report to the head of finance and will be carrying out the following tasks:

• Lead the accounting function and ensure compliant financial reporting.

• Manage, coach, and develop the accounting team (2 direct reports).
• Ensure accuracy and integrity of the General Ledger.
• Lead external audits and coordinate with auditors.

• Advise on accounting policies and complex transactions.
